es: Proyectar tendencias con prudencia: is set to, is projected to, is expected to reach y by then, más la duración con will have been + -ing.

teaching.en: The number of members is set to reach 1,200 by 2030, as long as the current rise continues at the same pace.
teaching.es: El número de socios está previsto que llegue a 1.200 para 2030, siempre que la subida actual continúe al mismo ritmo.
teaching.explanationEs: Is set to + verbo base: los datos apuntan a que ocurrirá. By 2030 equivale a «para 2030».
segments: The number of members is set to reach 1,200 by 2030,
as long as the current rise continues at the same pace.
teaching.audioText: The number of members is set to reach 1,200 by 2030, as long as the current rise continues at the same pace.

teaching.en: Daily steps are projected to rise by 10 percent over the next decade, assuming that nothing major changes in people's habits.
teaching.es: Se proyecta que los pasos diarios suban un 10 % durante la próxima década, suponiendo que no cambie nada importante en los hábitos de la gente.
teaching.explanationEs: Is/are projected to + verbo base: proyección que sale de un cálculo; es lenguaje propio de informes.
segments: Daily steps are projected to rise by 10 percent over the
next decade, assuming that nothing major changes in people's habits.
teaching.audioText: Daily steps are projected to rise by 10 percent over the next decade, assuming that nothing major changes in people's habits.

teaching.en: The club is expected to reach fifty teams, but the forecast could change if the league loses its main funding.
teaching.es: Se espera que el club llegue a cincuenta equipos, pero la previsión podría cambiar si la liga pierde su financiación principal.
teaching.explanationEs: Is expected to + verbo base dice lo que se espera. «Could change» añade prudencia.
segments: The club is expected to reach fifty teams, but the
forecast could change if the league loses its main funding.
teaching.audioText: The club is expected to reach fifty teams, but the forecast could change if the league loses its main funding.

teaching.en: By 2030 the league will have been growing for ten years, so more growth is likely, although it may not follow the same trajectory.
teaching.es: Para 2030 la liga llevará diez años creciendo, así que es probable que siga creciendo, aunque quizá no con la misma trayectoria.
teaching.explanationEs: Will have been + -ing mide cuánto dura algo hasta un momento futuro. Likely = probable; trajectory es el camino que sigue una línea.
segments: By 2030 the league will have been growing for ten years, so
more growth is likely, although it may not follow the same trajectory.
teaching.audioText: By 2030 the league will have been growing for ten years, so more growth is likely, although it may not follow the same trajectory.

teaching.en: Current figures suggest that the trend will continue, but this is only a rough estimate, and it rests on one important assumption.
teaching.es: Las cifras actuales sugieren que la tendencia continuará, pero esto es solo una estimación aproximada, y se apoya en un supuesto importante.
teaching.explanationEs: Rough estimate avisa de que no es una certeza; assumption es la condición que se da por buena para que el cálculo funcione.
segments: Current figures suggest that the trend will continue, but this is
only a rough estimate, and it rests on one important assumption.
teaching.audioText: Current figures suggest that the trend will continue, but this is only a rough estimate, and it rests on one important assumption.

teaching.en: The club is on track to double its membership by 2030, yet its income may hold steady, so the forecast remains uncertain.
teaching.es: El club va camino de duplicar sus socios para 2030, pero sus ingresos podrían mantenerse estables, así que la previsión sigue siendo incierta.
teaching.explanationEs: On track to + verbo base: lleva un ritmo que permite llegar a la meta; hold steady = no cambiar.
segments: The club is on track to double its membership by 2030,
yet its income may hold steady, so the forecast remains uncertain.

prompt.es: Lee el dato del club y elige la proyección que respeta el cálculo.

choices.text: The club will certainly have 1,000 members by 2030, whatever else happens.
The club is projected to reach about 1,300 members by 2030, if the pace holds.
The club is projected to reach about 1,000 members by 2030, if the pace holds.

feedback.es: Con 700 socios y unos 60 más al año, cinco años dan 1.000; la frase correcta calcula esa cifra y la presenta como proyección, no como promesa.

hint.es: Suma al dato actual el ritmo anual por los cinco años que faltan, y descarta lo que suena a promesa.

origin.text: Membership grew by about 60 people a year between 2020 and 2025, from 400 to 700. The treasurer's model assumes the same pace, so that pace is the only thing behind the figure for 2030.

prompt.es: Completa: «Para 2030, la liga llevará creciendo una década entera.»

feedback.es: Will have been + -ing expresa cuánto tiempo llevará algo ocurriendo en un momento futuro (2030).

hint.es: Es el participio de be que va entre will have y el verbo en -ing.

origin.text: The league started in 2020 with only eight teams. By 2030 it will have ___ growing for a whole decade, so a bigger calendar seems likely.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Se proyecta que los pasos diarios suban un 10 % en la próxima década.»

answer.text: Daily steps are projected to rise by 10 percent over the next decade

feedback.es: Are projected to + verbo base presenta la subida como resultado de un cálculo; by 10 percent da la cantidad del cambio.

hint.es: Empieza por el sujeto y sigue con are projected to.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige de qué depende la cifra de 600 socios.

choices.text: Of the pool staying open and the fees not changing.
Of the pool staying open and the fees going up.
Of the club opening a second pool and keeping the same fees.

feedback.es: La tesorera condiciona la cifra a dos supuestos: que la piscina siga abierta y que las cuotas no cambien.

origin.audio: Here is the treasurer's forecast. The club is set to reach six hundred members by 2030, but she was careful to add that this is only a rough estimate. It rests on one assumption: that the new pool stays open and that the fees stay the same. If either of those changes, she said, the figure is likely to be lower.

prompt.es: Relaciona cada frase de proyección con su traducción natural.

pairs.es: Está previsto que la cuota suba en mayo.

pairs: Sales are projected to fall by 4 percent.

pairs.es: Se proyecta que las ventas bajen un 4 %.

pairs: The club is on track to win the league.

pairs.es: El club va camino de ganar la liga.

pairs: Prices should hold steady this year.

pairs.es: Los precios deberían mantenerse estables este año.

feedback.es: Cada estructura marca una fuerza distinta: previsión fija, cálculo, ritmo hacia una meta y estabilidad.

prompt.es: Lee los datos de natación y elige la proyección más prudente.

choices.text: Membership will reach 200 by 2030 because the trend is certain to continue until then.
Membership is projected to reach roughly 200 by 2030, although this is only an estimate.
Membership is expected to be 200 in 2025, and it will keep growing until 2030 at least.

feedback.es: Con 160 socios en 2025 y un ritmo de 8 al año, unos 200 en 2030 es una proyección razonable, presentada como estimación.

origin.text: Data from the swimming club: there were 120 members in 2020 and 160 in 2025. The rise has been steady, about eight new members every year, with no sign of a sudden change.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué actitud muestra la alcaldesa ante las cifras.

choices.text: Doubtful, because she thinks the population will stop growing soon.
Relaxed, because she treats the figures as promises the town can count on.
Confident, but warning that the figures depend on one condition.

feedback.es: La alcaldesa ve probable la necesidad de un segundo centro, pero advierte de que el cálculo depende de una condición y pide no tomar las cifras como promesas.

origin.audio: The local council has published its forecasts for the next decade. According to the report, the population of the town is projected to reach thirty thousand by 2035, and the number of children in school is expected to fall as the town grows older. The mayor said the town is on track to need a second health centre, but she added a warning: the forecast depends on one condition, that young families keep moving away. If that changes, the picture could look quite different. Residents were told not to take the figures as promises.

prompt.es: Con el mismo audio, elige qué cambiaría el panorama que presenta el informe.

choices.text: That young families stopped leaving the town.
That the school lost some of its pupils to other towns.
That the council built the second health centre earlier.

feedback.es: Si las familias jóvenes dejaran de marcharse, la condición del cálculo dejaría de cumplirse y el panorama cambiaría.

origin.audio: The local council has published its forecasts for the next decade. According to the report, the population of the town is projected to reach thirty thousand by 2035, and the number of children in school is expected to fall as the town grows older. The mayor said the town is on track to need a second health centre, but she added a warning: the forecast depends on one condition, that young families keep moving away. If that changes, the picture could look quite different. Residents were told not to take the figures as promises.

prompt.es: Completa: «La previsión es tan fiable como su suposición de que la tendencia no cambiará.»

feedback.es: Assumption es la suposición de partida de un cálculo; si falla, la previsión deja de servir.

origin.text: Every forecast is only as reliable as its ___ that the current trend will not change. If that fails, even a careful estimate will give the wrong figure.

prompt.es: Escribe una sola frase de proyección con are projected to, el plazo y una cautela.

answer.text: Daily steps are projected to rise to 8,000 by 2030, although this is only a rough estimate based on current habits.
accepted: Daily steps are projected to rise to 8,000 by 2030, although this is only a rough estimate based on current habits.
By 2030, daily steps are projected to reach 8,000, but this is only an estimate that could change.
Daily steps are projected to grow to 8,000 by 2030, assuming that people's habits do not change.

feedback.es: La frase lleva are projected to + verbo base, el plazo by 2030, la cifra y una cautela (only an estimate, could change o assuming that).

origin.text: Dato: hoy se dan 7.000 pasos diarios y el cálculo indica 8.000 en 2030 si los hábitos no cambian. Escribe una frase con are projected to, el plazo y una cautela.

prompt.es: Lee el extracto y elige qué quiere dar a entender el autor con su admisión.

choices.text: That the stadium will open late, so the club will lose many fans.
That the projected doubling is less certain than it first appears.
That the forecasts are wrong and have to be done again.

feedback.es: Al admitir que solo hay tres años de datos y que se supone que el estadio abrirá a tiempo, el autor relativiza el doble de asistencia previsto.

origin.text: The report's forecasts look convincing at first: attendance is expected to double by 2030. However, the authors admit that their forecast uses only three years of data, and that it supposes that the new stadium will open on time.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué se espera para las ventas del año que viene.

choices.text: No change, since sales are already forecast to hold steady.
A rise in sales, since the supermarket will have closed by then.
A fall in sales, since a new supermarket will be open nearby.

feedback.es: El audio dice que para entonces la nueva tienda llevará dos años abierta, por lo que las ventas probablemente bajarán.

origin.audio: Our sales are projected to hold steady this year, but the forecast for next year is much less clear. By then, the new supermarket across the street will have been open for two years, so our figures are likely to fall.

prompt.es: Completa: «Se proyecta que la población de la ciudad se duplique en una década.»

feedback.es: Decade es un periodo de diez años; within a decade sitúa la proyección dentro de ese plazo.

origin.text: Experts disagree about the long run. Even so, the town's population is projected to double within a ___, reaching sixty thousand by the mid-2030s.
